title: On the Trustworthiness Landscape of State-of-the-art Generative Models: A Survey and Outlook
benchmark_measurement: The paper, being a survey, does not conduct its own benchmarks but reviews literature that measures various trustworthiness dimensions. In the context of fairness, it mentions the measurement of stereotypes, where religious affiliation is cited as a typical category for such bias.
findings: The paper identifies religious affiliation as a category of characteristics upon which models can form harmful stereotypes, but provides no specific findings related to any particular religion as it is not a focus of the survey.
